correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs the power-sum prime-power congruence, proves an exact obstruction sieve for both Q, isolates prime 43 and all p=43k+1, justifies natural densities by absolutely summable reciprocal moduli, establishes exact residue uniformity modulo 43 for the common sieve, and obtains strict inequality using two rational finite-sum certificates and explicit telescoping/integral tails. All boundary conditions Q positive even and k positive even are checked; the 21-prime and 109-index certificates were independently rerun from the attached standalone checker. Direct finite tests are only supplementary.
